usage: opsward [-h] {diagnose,generate,maintain,recommend,install-skills,find} ...

positional arguments:
  {diagnose,generate,maintain,recommend,install-skills,find}
    diagnose            Diagnose the AI agent setup of one or more projects. :param project_roots:
                        one or more paths to project directories :param format: output format —
                        'text' or 'json' :param verbose: show additional detail in text output
                        :param min_score: minimum overall score to pass (exit 0); below this exits
                        1
    generate            Generate missing AI setup artifacts for one or more projects. By default,
                        shows what would be created (dry run). Use --write to actually write
                        files. Existing files are never overwritten. :param project_roots: one or
                        more paths to project directories :param write: actually write files
                        (default: dry run) :param format: output format — 'text' or 'json' :param
                        agents_md: also generate AGENTS.md (cross-platform agent instructions)
                        :param hooks: also generate starter hook scripts
    maintain            Check for stale references, out-of-sync docs, and other drift. :param
                        project_roots: one or more paths to project directories :param format:
                        output format — 'text' or 'json'
    recommend           Recommend ecosystem skills based on the project's tech stack. Analyzes
                        dependencies and suggests skills from the community catalog. :param
                        project_roots: one or more paths to project directories :param format:
                        output format — 'text' or 'json'
    install-skills      Install opsward's Claude Code skills (and agents) into a project or
                        globally. By default, shows what would be created (dry run). Use --write
                        to actually write files. Existing files are never overwritten. :param
                        target: project directory (ignored when --global is set) :param
                        global_install: install into ~/.claude/ instead of the project :param
                        agents: also install agent definitions (default: True) :param write:
                        actually write files (default: dry run)
    find                Find assets (skills, agents, docs) across one or more projects by QUERY.
                        Cross-repo asset discovery via the toolery package (install with: pip
                        install 'opsward[discovery]'). :param query: search query :param
                        project_roots: one or more project directories (default: current dir)
                        :param kinds: comma-separated asset kinds — skill, agent, doc :param
                        semantic: use toolery's ir semantic backend (needs toolery[ir]) :param
                        limit: max results to show

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

usage: opsward diagnose [-h] [-f FORMAT] [-v] [-m MIN_SCORE] [project-roots ...]

Diagnose the AI agent setup of one or more projects.

:param project_roots: one or more paths to project directories
:param format: output format — 'text' or 'json'
:param verbose: show additional detail in text output
:param min_score: minimum overall score to pass (exit 0); below this exits 1

positional arguments:
  project-roots         -

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -f FORMAT, --format FORMAT
                        'text'
  -v, --verbose         False
  -m MIN_SCORE, --min-score MIN_SCORE
                        80

usage: opsward generate [-h] [-w] [-f FORMAT] [-a] [--hooks] [project-roots ...]

Generate missing AI setup artifacts for one or more projects.

By default, shows what would be created (dry run). Use --write to
actually write files. Existing files are never overwritten.

:param project_roots: one or more paths to project directories
:param write: actually write files (default: dry run)
:param format: output format — 'text' or 'json'
:param agents_md: also generate AGENTS.md (cross-platform agent instructions)
:param hooks: also generate starter hook scripts

positional arguments:
  project-roots         -

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -w, --write           False
  -f FORMAT, --format FORMAT
                        'text'
  -a, --agents-md       False
  --hooks               False

usage: opsward maintain [-h] [-f FORMAT] [project-roots ...]

Check for stale references, out-of-sync docs, and other drift.

:param project_roots: one or more paths to project directories
:param format: output format — 'text' or 'json'

positional arguments:
  project-roots         -

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -f FORMAT, --format FORMAT
                        'text'

usage: opsward recommend [-h] [-f FORMAT] [project-roots ...]

Recommend ecosystem skills based on the project's tech stack.

Analyzes dependencies and suggests skills from the community catalog.

:param project_roots: one or more paths to project directories
:param format: output format — 'text' or 'json'

positional arguments:
  project-roots         -

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -f FORMAT, --format FORMAT
                        'text'

usage: opsward install-skills [-h] [-t TARGET] [-g] [-a] [-w]

Install opsward's Claude Code skills (and agents) into a project or globally.

By default, shows what would be created (dry run). Use --write to
actually write files. Existing files are never overwritten.

:param target: project directory (ignored when --global is set)
:param global_install: install into ~/.claude/ instead of the project
:param agents: also install agent definitions (default: True)
:param write: actually write files (default: dry run)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -t TARGET, --target TARGET
                        '.'
  -g, --global-install  False
  -a, --agents          True
  -w, --write           False

usage: opsward find [-h] [-k KINDS] [-s] [-l LIMIT] query [project-roots ...]

Find assets (skills, agents, docs) across one or more projects by QUERY.

Cross-repo asset discovery via the toolery package
(install with: pip install 'opsward[discovery]').

:param query: search query
:param project_roots: one or more project directories (default: current dir)
:param kinds: comma-separated asset kinds — skill, agent, doc
:param semantic: use toolery's ir semantic backend (needs toolery[ir])
:param limit: max results to show

positional arguments:
  query                 -
  project-roots         -

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -k KINDS, --kinds KINDS
                        'skill,agent'
  -s, --semantic        False
  -l LIMIT, --limit LIMIT
                        10
